title: Publish related record decisions as one coherent update
actor: An engineering agent recording a set of related explicit decisions
goal: Publish the supplied related decisions together so subsequent readers can rely on a coherent recorded state.
context: The update introduces a new supporting record and a related reference with explicitly chosen applicability; intermediate content would be incomplete.
trigger: The agent submits one bounded batch against an observed revision.
preconditions: The operations are explicitly supplied, within one selected current-format change, and have no conflicting target assignments.
Expected revision and relevant subject identities come from the actor's actual inspected basis.

interaction.action: Submits the related explicit operations with required applicability and expected state.
Accepts the complete combined candidate only if its final references, preservation rules, and freshness conditions hold.
Publishes the related recorded decisions coherently or returns an explicit conflict, busy, rejection, or recoverable interruption outcome.
Uses the returned storage receipt and current reads to distinguish committed work from a retry that requires reassessment.

expected_outcome: All requested decisions are durably committed before saved is reported; readers receive a coherent state and the agent does not infer workflow approval from publication.

alternatives.condition: An identical candidate is submitted against a freshly checked current revision.
alternatives.outcome: The result is unchanged with no duplicate entry or semantic increment.

alternatives.condition: Requested diagnostic detail exceeds the ordinary receipt.
alternatives.outcome: The result retains a fitting storage receipt and exposes omitted detail without turning a successful publication into rejection.

failures.condition: A previous success response was lost and the agent retries using the old revision.
failures.outcome: The system returns conflict rather than duplicating entries or silently accepting stale decision basis.

failures.condition: A competing writer or observed external basis change invalidates the expected state.
failures.outcome: The system reports busy or conflict and preserves the coherent winning work.
The system exposes recovery-required instead of saved or a usable mixed state; explicit recovery is a separate request.
